item.title: The P1S AMS 2 Pro Combo Is $579. The P2S Combo Is $699. Here's Which One to Buy.
item.description: Bambu dropped the P1S to $399 and the AMS 2 Pro combo to $579. The P2S combo is $699. That $120 gap is the whole buying decision, and the answer isn't what the spec sheet suggests.
